## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The backtest uses BS-synthetic pricing with implicit 1-contract scale. Real trading requires sufficient capital to cover risk per contract (e.g., $25K+ for full qty per risk-rules.md). This analysis does not propose live trading; account sizing is not applicable to the BS-sim baseline.
2. **Sample bias:** The grinder uses the full available historical SPY/VIX dataset (no selection bias in this run). Overfit risk is minimal as no parameters were optimized.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this is an in-sample Stage-1 run; no OOS validation performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS-sim used; real OPRA fills not involved)
5. **Failure modes:** Base engine loses on 2/3 J winner days (4/29, 5/01) and wins on 5/04. Edge_capture (759.21) falls below OP-16 floor (771), indicating the base engine would be REJECTED under OP-16. No catastrophic losses observed on J loser days (engine P&L=0).
6. **Concentration:** Wide P&L = -$1,464.23 over 225 trades (WR=18.7%). Top5_pct=999.0 (placeholder indicating undefined due to negative total P&L). The strategy loses money overall; concentration metric is irrelevant for losing strategies.
